name: shop-schedule
title: Shop Schedule
description: A job shop's schedule with real limits: every job's operations placed on each work center's actual hours, start dates locked at release so a missed start shows red the day it happens, the projected date at the customer's dock against the commit date, a queue for each work center, the load by week, and the morning meeting in facts (part, quantity, date, last and next operation).

/job/:id.label: One job: what is done and what is left
